window_method: First upstream request start through later of last received token (start+TTFT+sum ITLs) and last async completion, same-host perf_counter. Client process import/reporting excluded.

assumptions.architecture: 60 dense layers: 50 sliding_attention (32 Q,16 KV,dim256,window1024), 10 full_attention (32 Q,4 KV,dim512,K=V shared projection); hidden5376, intermediate21504, vocab262144; TP4
assumptions.prefill: Useful dense projection and causal/sliding QK+AV multiply-adds only; one LM head row per nonempty adapter prefill row. Padding, softmax, norm, GELU and rotary arithmetic omitted from useful-FLOP numerator; all remain in wall-time denominator.
assumptions.weights: BFP4_B 576bytes/1024elements including shared exponents. Physical MLP intermediate22528 and output5632 padding from multichip_decoder.py; full TP-sharded weights read once per decode replay, not once per user. LoFi all projection groups.
assumptions.kv: BFP8_B 1088bytes/1024elements; estimated one K and V read per attended token and write per active row; global K=V projection shared but attention consumes both K and V. Cache reuse, SDPA tile rounding and repeated reads are not measured.
assumptions.other_dram: Includes replicated BF16 norm weights, approximate residual/collective staging, embedding and logits; one physical32-row tile for all supported decode batches. L1 reuse and exact temporary/CCL traffic unknown. This is modeled DRAM traffic, not a hardware counter; no claim of exact utilization.

peak_basis.scope: Whole participating ASIC theoretical LoFi peak, including dispatch-reserved cores. This is not the active matmul grid's peak.
